title: An opened handle creates at a distance, and the pinned three-point premise fails
subject: Whether new knots appear exactly at gluing lines on handles in spaces built from Fano planes and plane pieces
conclusion: No new knot appeared unless the gluing line lies on a handle or the removal opens a handle attached at a point, which then creates at plane gluing lines out to distance 5; when the cut carries one bit, a screening lemma reduces creation to a plane knot space. Near opened handles 1,092 of 2,496 new knots are unpinned three-point knots, and four-point new knots appear inside handles, so the pinned three-point premise fails on composite spaces.
